comparison.objective: Remove four breakaway supports from a 3D-printed part over a scrap bin and place the clean part in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a part, twist or break small attachments, capture debris, and place the finished part.
comparison.success_condition: All supports detached and deposited in the bin, clean part in tray, no drop or loss, bodies still and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests sequential breakaway removal and debris capture; no apertures, agitation-based sorting, or retained-versus-passed population.
